description: Financial astrology event calendar for backtesting and trading bots (stocks, crypto, forex): the exact UTC minute and unix timestamp of every eclipse, Mercury retrograde and other station, ingress, new and full moon, planetary aspect, declination parallel and out-of-bounds between two dates, 1800-2200, each with a stable key to join on candles. E.g. {start: '2024-01-01', end: '2024-12-31', include: ['eclipse', 'station']}. A reproducible calendar of celestial events for backtests and alerts, historical or future: sign ingresses, retrograde/direct stations, new/full/quarter moons, solar eclipses (total, annular, hybrid, partial, with gamma) and lunar eclipses (with magnitudes), aspects between planets, declination parallels / contra-parallels and out-of-bounds crossings. Up to 366 days per call, geocentric or heliocentric, tropical or sidereal, Moon optional. Each event has exact_utc, a unix 'timestamp' to join on candle times and a stable 'key' for de-duplication across pages. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.25 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/finance/events (x402 or MPP); always paid, never a free call.

aspects.description: Aspects timed between planets. Default: the 5 majors.

bodies.description: Planets searched. Default: Sun..Pluto (geo), Mercury..Pluto with Earth (helio).

end.description: Last UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days after start (inclusive).

include.description: Event types to return. Default: all that apply to the perspective.

include_moon.description: Also the Moon's ingresses, aspects, parallels and out-of-bounds (geocentric; many events).

perspective.description: Heliocentric gives ingresses and aspects only (no stations, lunations, eclipses).

name: astro_event_calendar

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

counts.description: Number of events of each type.

events.description: Events in time order, each with 'type' (ingress, station, lunation, eclipse, aspect, declination, out_of_bounds), its details, 'exact_utc', unix 'timestamp' and a stable 'key'.

settings.description: Settings applied: date range, perspective, zodiac, event types, bodies, aspects, frame, precision and the eclipse method.

title: Eclipse & Mercury retrograde calendar (market timing)
